On this walk you examine water management and settlement planning at a Harappan city.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • UNESCO site orientation
  • Settlement planning viewpoints
  • Water-system interpretation
  • Rethink resilience and environmental claims

How the time is spent

  1. UNESCO site orientation 30 min

  2. Settlement planning viewpoints 60 min

  3. Water-system interpretation 65 min

  4. Rethink resilience and environmental claims 25 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.

Where
Dholavira, Gujarat
For
